question:
Among the comments with scores between 5 to 10, what is the percentage of the users with 0 up votes?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: percentage = DIVIDE(COUNT(UserId where UpVotes = 0 and Score BETWEEN 5 and 10))*100, (COUNT(UserId where Score BETWEEN 5 and 10));

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN u.XCL_061 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.XCL_010 = u.XCL_052
WHERE c.XCL_007 BETWEEN 5 AND 10;
